worldcombat.skill.playrough.summary: Tumble into the target and bowl it over with your whole body, shoving it back and possibly lowering its Attack by 1 stage; the romping form rolls on to a second nearby enemy.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.use.0: Charge in and knock a foe off its feet
worldcombat.skill.playrough.use.1: Roll back and forth between clustered enemies
The pounce deals about %1$s physical damage; when Romping, if another enemy stands within %3$s blocks of the impact it rolls on to deal about %2$s more.
Each target hit has a %1$s chance to lose %2$s stage(s) of Attack.
The pounce charges %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, shoving a hit target back about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.romp.on: Romping: longer charge, faster roll, harder shove, wider reach to a second target, shorter wind-up and cooldown, at the cost of lighter hits and a rarer Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.romp.off: Solid tackle: a shorter charge with heavier hits and a more reliable Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.growth.0: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s power and the roll to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.growth.1: From level %1$s the pounce rises to %2$s power and %3$s Attack-drop chance.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.preference.r: On: longer charge, faster roll, harder shove, wider roll-on range, shorter wind-up and cooldown, but both hits are lighter and the Attack drop is rarer. Off (solid tackle): a shorter charge with heavier hits and a more reliable Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.playrough.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before charging; larger values let it start rolling from further away.
On: when another enemy stands within 3 blocks of the target it charges in, letting the romping form roll on. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
On: lower-health targets rank higher. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
The roll sweeps with a %1$s block hit radius and is stopped by terrain or a body in the way; it whiffs if it strikes no one.
